name: high-precision-pdf-to-docx
description: High precision PDF to DOCX converter engine using C++ WASM

scripts.build:wasm: emcc wasm/pdf_converter_bridge.cpp src/LayoutAnalyzer.cpp src/DocxGenerator.cpp third_party/miniz/miniz.c third_party/miniz/miniz_tdef.c third_party/miniz/miniz_tinfl.c third_party/miniz/miniz_zip.c -O3 -s WASM=1 -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=['ccall','cwrap','HEAPU8'] -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -o lib/pdf_converter_wasm.js

author: Antigravity
